---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible defect
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Description

What happened, and what did you expect instead?

## Reproduction

List the smallest reliable sequence of steps.

## Environment

Include the version or commit, operating environment, and relevant configuration
with secrets removed.

## Evidence

Add sanitized logs, screenshots, or test output. Report security vulnerabilities
privately as described in `SECURITY.md`.
